note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), the original in English; alate unknown, soldier and worker known; the number of antennal segments in the original is given as '? segments' and is not recorded; the postclypeus length of the worker and the postclypeus and pronotum widths are given in the original as '0.15..0.17' and '0.45..0.50', with double dots from OCR defects, and are therefore not recorded; literature citations, figure numbers and distribution are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, longer than wide, width/length ratio 0.76; mandibles thick and short, sickle-shaped, base thick and wide, each with a pointed tooth situated at the apical third; postmentum club-shaped, anterior margin convex, posterior margin more deeply concave; pronotum with the anterior margin convex and without a notch. Alate not described.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow, mandible base slightly tinged with brown; mandibles brown, paler at the base; antennae, labrum, legs and body paler than the head. Head and body with numerous hairs. Body length about 4.0 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, longer than wide; head length to mandible base 1.27 mm, maximum width 0.97 mm, width/length ratio 0.76; dorsum convex in lateral view, frons slightly sloping anteriorly. Anteclypeus sub-trapezoidal, hairless, projecting anteriorly in the middle; postclypeus subrectangular, hairy. The number of antennal segments is defective in the original. Segment 3 shortest. Labrum broadly tongue-shaped, wider than long; length 0.20 mm, width 0.30 mm. Mandibles thick and short, sickle-shaped, base thick and wide; length 0.60–0.63 mm, basal width 0.43 mm; each with a pointed tooth situated at the apical third. Postmentum club-shaped, widest at the anterior third, weakly narrowing posteriorly to a thick waist; anterior margin convex, posterior margin more deeply concave; median length 0.87 mm, maximum width 0.37 mm, waist width 0.30 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin convex and without a notch, posterior margin slightly convex; length 0.27 mm, width 0.43 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow, paler in the middle; antennae, labrum, thorax and legs paler; abdomen greyish owing to gut contents showing through. Head and body with dense hairs. Body length 3.00–3.40 mm. Head subcircular, slightly wider than the head length to mandible base; head length 0.63–0.67 mm, width 0.73–0.77 mm. Anteclypeus hairless, trapezoidal, projecting anteriorly in the middle; postclypeus raised, hairy, width 0.37 mm. Labrum broadly tongue-shaped. Mandibles of the Euhamitermes type. Pronotum similar to that of the soldier, length 0.20–0.30 mm.
